title: First-time Player registration end-to-end (Milestone 002)
translation_policy: Faithful English translation of the original Japanese prompt and visible AI interaction used during development. No summary, beautification, or added requirements. Code, commands, file paths, URLs, identifiers, and error messages are kept in their original form.
notes: First real vertical slice for WildLive: iPhone Simulator → SwiftUI → Laravel API → PostgreSQL for first-time player registration. Stacked on ai/013-ios-ui-prototype (base_commit c20e8bd), which itself stacks on ai/011-ios-title-screen (PR #12, still open). When PR #12 merges and ai/013 merges, this branch will re-target main automatically. No X manifest per the Milestone 001 §27 precedent — pre-review UI-visible iterations are not themselves auto-post-on-merge targets. pr_number / pr_url / merge_commit / ci_status remain null until the human authorises push + PR + merge.
